title: Which Box Hides the Dragon?
youtube_description:
One of these three boxes is hiding a dragon — but which one? Watch to find out! 🐉📦 Come back tomorrow for an even trickier challenge!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #FunForKids #Kidify #PuzzleForKids #GuessTheAnswer

scenes.narration: A dragon is hiding in one of these boxes — but which one?
Is it the red box, the blue box, or the green box?
Pick your box! You have three seconds — three, two, one!
The red box — let's open it! Oh no, it's just a rubber chicken!
The blue box — surely this one? Nope! It's a giant pile of socks!
That means the green box is the winner — and there's the dragon! You found it!
Nice work! Come back tomorrow for Level 2 — it's way trickier!
